messages:
Andrew (AE): Heads up — Board pushed back: they require IdP attestation + encrypted SSO tokens before signing. They want proof of key separation, monthly access logs, and a short statement on who holds keys. Meeting with their CTO at 10:00am PT tomorrow. Can Eng/OPS confirm if Private (VPC + customer-managed KMS) + CloudHSM path is doable in ~2 weeks? Also need a pricing delta for a dedicated annual commit to present to the board.
Marie (SE): Quick presales summary: we support VPC + customer-managed KMS (envelope encryption). CloudHSM integration is supported but requires network peering and IAM mappings. On‑prem HSM is a bigger lift. Baseline private install ~5 business days; CloudHSM attestation/certing ~7–10 days after we get customer ARNs & peering details.
Sanjay (Eng): Feasibility notes: yes for AWS CloudHSM in their account. Need exact region (GovCloud vs commercial), instance types, and model sizes. Blockers: no ARNs/CIDR yet, and peering config. If they insist on on‑prem HSM, add ~3 weeks and additional eng effort.
Lia (Legal): We need the security questionnaire answers by EOD to unblock contracting. If they require HSM/on‑prem, we'll need SOC2 addendum and KMS appendix. Also need clarity on data residency/data-escrow requirements.
Jordan (CSM): I'll pull ARNs and the infra contact. I can also schedule a post-board deep dive with their CTO + infra. Sharing internal architecture playbook for this flow: https://redwood-internal/archs/priv-kms (internal).
ops-bot: Ticket created: TKT-4821 — "HelixBank IdP/HSM escalation". Assignees: eng-oncall, legal-team. Link: https://redwood-ops/tickets/TKT-4821
Andrew (AE): For pricing — need 3 quick options we can present: 1) Hosted commit (standard) 2) Dedicated commit + CloudHSM integration 3) Full private with on‑prem HSM (SOW + eng). Ballpark numbers acceptable for board. Finance, can you give quick ranges?
Marie (SE): Ballpark (very rough): 1) Standard commit: ~$45k/mo. 2) Dedicated + CloudHSM: ~$65k/mo. 3) Full private + on‑prem HSM: one‑time eng effort ~$120k + ~$95k/mo. Please treat as placeholder until Finance signs off.
Andrew (AE): Lia — can Legal fast‑turn the SOW and KMS appendix? Need redline-ready doc by tomorrow noon.
Lia (Legal): Prioritizing. Please drop the completed security questionnaire and any customer-required clauses in this thread so we can triage immediately.
Jordan (CSM): Dropping questionnaire link in DM to Legal and will DM infra contact for ARNs now. Their CTO handle in slack is @CTO_helix — they're on the 10am.
Marie (SE): Engineering action items (short): 1) Sanjay to confirm CloudHSM path + required ARNs/CIDRs. 2) Sanjay to list exact infra sizing (A100 equivalents?) needed to price Dedicated. 3) If on‑prem HSM, provide eng effort estimate. I'll draft an architecture slide and short script for the CTO call; will share by 6pm.
Sanjay (Eng): Acknowledged. Initial checklist: required ARNs, peering CIDR, preferred region, SSO IdP metadata, and model sizes. Estimate: 2 engineers x 5 days to provision cloud path; on‑prem HSM adds ~3 weeks + one integration engineer.
ops-bot: Reminder: GovCloud can restrict some deploy tooling — see runbook: https://redwood-runbooks/govcloud-deploy
Andrew (AE): Great. Finance ping (Rachel): can we get an expedited pricing confirmation this afternoon? We need numbers for the board packet.
Marie (SE): Quick sample command for their infra team to capture KMS ARN & region: ```aws kms describe-key --key-id <key-id> --region us-gov-west-1``` — ask them to return full ARN + account ID.
Lia (Legal): If customer provides KMS key in their account (preferred), we need an explicit clause mapping key control responsibilities. I'll draft language and share.
Jordan (CSM): I'll confirm their availability for a 20–30m architecture handoff call right after the 10am board slot.
Andrew (AE): If anyone can't make the 10am, reply now. We may need a combined Legal+Eng presence on the call.
Marie (SE): :thumbsup:
Jordan (CSM): :raising_hand: I can join and share ARNs live.
Lia (Legal): :ok_hand: I'll be on standby and will join if legal items come up.
Sanjay (Eng): :eyes: prepping list, will post ARNs checklist once I get the infra DM.
Andrew (AE): Thanks team — priority: get questionnaire answers + ARNs into this thread today and a finance ballpark. We'll iterate in the call.
